Supplier contract risk review.overall: The contract meets the policy on payment terms, but its liability cap falls short and public liability insurance is missing.

findings.contract_says: Granitebeck will invoice weekly. The Customer will pay within 30 days of the invoice date.
findings.note: Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date, as the policy asks.

findings.contract_says: Granitebeck is liable for loss of or damage to the goods while in its care, up to £100 per pallet unless the loss is caused by its negligence.
findings.note: Its liability for the goods is limited to £100 per pallet, far below the annual value, which is at least £42,000 from the minimum monthly charge of £3,500.

findings.contract_says: Granitebeck will insure the goods in its care for their replacement value.
findings.note: The supplier must insure the goods in its care, but the contract does not require public liability insurance.
The contract ends on 31 December 2028 and does not renew automatically.
Nothing in the contract shows the supplier handling personal data.
